summary: Iteration 69 - ICS Export with RRULE, Series ICS, Single Occurrence Delete: All 15 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend tests verified SeriesManagerDialog with cancel-occ buttons, series-ical-btn, and series badges showing 'Serie X/Y' format. Fixed bug in validate_schedule_slot() that prevented custom recurring meetings from generating series.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed bug in /app/backend/services/meetings_recurring.py - validate_schedule_slot() now handles string weekday names ('mon', 'tue', etc.) and 'time' field (single time with default 60min duration) in addition to integer weekdays and start_time/end_time
ICS export correctly includes RRULE for simple patterns (daily/weekly/biweekly/monthly) with proper FREQ and INTERVAL values
Series ICS export generates multi-VEVENT calendar with distinct DTSTART times for each occurrence
DELETE /api/meetings/{meeting_id} correctly removes single occurrence while leaving other series members intact
SeriesManagerDialog UI correctly shows occurrence list with cancel buttons (data-testid='cancel-occ-{i}') and series ICS download button (data-testid='series-ical-btn')
seed_data_creation: Test series meetings created during tests (cleaned up after tests)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 69 tested: (1) GET /api/meetings/{id}/ical - verified RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY for weekly, RRULE:FREQ=DAILY for daily, RRULE with INTERVAL=2 for biweekly, RRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY for monthly. Also verified ORGANIZER with host email/CN, ATTENDEE lines for invited participants, URL with join link, meeting code in description. (2) GET /api/meetings/series/{series_id}/ical - verified multi-VEVENT ICS with distinct DTSTART times for custom series (2 weekdays x 2 weeks = 4 VEVENTs). Returns 404 for unknown series. (3) DELETE /api/meetings/{meeting_id} for single occurrence - verified only deletes that one occurrence, GET /api/meetings/recurring/{series_id} shows one fewer. (4) Frontend SeriesManagerDialog - verified data-testid='series-manager-dialog', occurrence rows with data-testid='series-occ-{i}', cancel buttons with data-testid='cancel-occ-{i}', series ICS button with data-testid='series-ical-btn' labeled 'Alle als ICS'. (5) Series badges show 'Serie X/Y' format (e.g., 'Serie 1/2', 'Serie 2/2') and are clickable to open SeriesManagerDialog. (6) PROCESS_REVIEW.md file exists at /app/memory/PROCESS_REVIEW.md with comprehensive process recommendations.
